title: scheduler/config/scheduler.json and executor.json: every tunable of the scheduler and the verb table of the executor, validated by the schemas beside them, variables resolved at load, the state root by variable, no default in Go
text: Revised 2026-10-13 (SPEC-16.G 1.1.0): the 1.0.0 file read records from an array of roots under the home directory and kept a state directory of its own; runtime data left git for one state root (cards C10, C11, C15), so the state root and cache root are variables, the records root is one tree, and the probe thresholds, the sixty-second idle limit, leases, per-kind timings and the two loop budgets (card C26) are keys. Rejected: an intake roots array with one entry, which invites the slot copying card C17 closed. Cost: a 1.0.0 scheduler.json fails at load by name.
